named_references.text: ROKSANA : «I came too early… He’ll be here soon.»
ROKSANA : «He’s come before, right?»
ROKSANA : «Him.»
ROKSANA : «Ludwig.»
ROKSANA : «Oh, but you do.»
ROKSANA : «For reasons I can’t explain, he chose you. It’s quite obvious…»
ROKSANA : «But, to answer your question, no. No, I do not see him. I have never seen him.»
ROKSANA : «The name may not ring a bell now… but soon…»
ROKSANA : «He’ll be sitting right here, STARING at you with his dead little eyes!»
ROKSANA : «Of course they exist. What a stupid thing to say. Pointless, really.»
ROKSANA : «But you think they could exist?»
ROKSANA : «Nice. What a lovely way to see the world.»
ROKSANA : «You’re quite surprising. Unusual, actually.»
ROKSANA : «I am a ghost hunter, sir.»
ROKSANA : «Some creatures from the Nether-World live among us, encrusting themselves onto our lives like barnacles.»
ROKSANA : «Like oysters!»
ROKSANA : «Ghosts are parasites. Dead weight bearing down on our shoulders and back.»
ROKSANA : «Of course, sir. Not believing in something doesn’t make it any less dangerous.»
ROKSANA : «On the contrary…»
ROKSANA : «I’m not crazy. And that word… is horrendous. Dirty. Don’t use it.»
ROKSANA : «I couldn’t care less what you think of me. Honestly.»
ROKSANA : «No, no. That’s what he wants you to believe. What he wants you to think.»
ROKSANA : «I’m not going to beat around the bush, sir.»
ROKSANA : «You need to keep two essential things in mind.»
ROKSANA : «Ludwig IS evil incarnate.»
ROKSANA : «He is a tour guide from the Underworld trying to sell you your own death.»
ROKSANA : «His cold fingers gripping on the edge of your window… I can feel it. I know it. They’ll soon be here, holding on, just like this.»
ROKSANA : «You have two essential things to keep in mind and that was the first.»
ROKSANA : «The second is even more important.»
ROKSANA : «Do not make him angry. Listen to him. Help him. Make friends with him.»
ROKSANA : «He will take you with him to the Underworld… for all eternity.»
ROKSANA : «It’s easy to think that Ludwig is a child. He’s no child.»
ROKSANA : «He is a creature that has lived for centuries.»
ROKSANA : «A demon. Dangerous. Violent.»
ROKSANA : «Don’t forget. Make friends. No matter what.»
ROKSANA : «You folks are unbelievable.»
ROKSANA : «I’m saving your life. And you want me to pay?»
